newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX crude seen ending with an "inside day".
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude seen ending with an "inside day".

text.p: NYMEX crude remained weaker late session Thursday as firmer gasoline prices failed to offset a decline in heating oil and kept crude in price range set Wedndesday.
"We've hit support, and we should have an inside day today," said a chartist in Chicago of crude.
April crude was off 26 cents a barrel at $20.85. March gasoline was up 0.34 cent a gallon at at 62.60 cents while March heating oil was off 0.78 cent at 55.90 cents.
Gasoline's strength was due mostly to short covering in the prompt month ahead of the March expiry in refined products on Friday. The back months were weak.
April gasoline was off 0.04 cent a gallon at 63.65 cents.
Heating oil sagged as forecasts called for temperatures to continue seasonally mild in the key heating oil market of the northeastern United States as winter drew to a close.
